equipment.name: Arcane compulsion
equipment.desc: Reduce enemy Charge movements targeting the bearer and their attached unit by 2".

equipment.name: Arcane litanies
equipment.desc: The model or its attached unit ignore the first Perils of the Warp effect they suffer each game.

equipment.name: Astral Grimoire
equipment.desc: Select one friendly unit within 12" during the Reinforcement phase. For the remainder of the battle round the unit got a Movement value of 12" and gains the "Anti-Grav" ability. Unique.

equipment.name: Athanaean Scroll
equipment.desc: If a test to manifest a psychic power rolls any doubles, the power is manifested and can't be denied. If a test to deny a psychic power rolls any doubles, the power is denied regardless of the actual result. Unique.

equipment.name: Helm of the Third Eye
equipment.desc: The model and any attached unit ignore any or all to hit modifiers, including for Defensive Fire. Unique.

equipment.name: Hourglass of Destiny
equipment.desc:
Roll a die the first time the model is eliminated: 
1,2 - Remove the model.
3,4 - Set it back up with 1 wound. 
5,6 - Set it up again with 2 wounds.
Unique.

equipment.name: Magister
equipment.desc: The model gains the "Psyker" ability and may cast 2 powers and deny 2 powers per battle round. It knows Smite, both powers from a chosen Prosperine Cult discipline and all powers from a chosen General discipline. Additionally, it gains the "Brotherhood of Psykers" ability. Legion Praetor only.

equipment.name: Prosperine lore
equipment.desc: The model gains the "Psyker" ability and may cast 1 power and deny 1 power per battle round. It knows Smite, both powers from a chosen Prosperine Cult discipline and all powers from a chosen General discipline. Additionally, it gains the "Brotherhood of Psykers" ability. Legion Centurion only.

equipment.name: Tizcan Tutelary
equipment.desc: Can be activated once per game to grant friendly and enemy psykers a +1 bonus to manifestation rolls until the next battle round. Unique.

equipment.name: Weaver of Primordial Force
equipment.desc:
The model may give itself one of these bonuses each round:
- Change one "Normal" psychic power to "Basic".
- Change one "Complex" psychic power to "Normal".
- Get a +1 bonus to manifest one psychic power.
- Get a +1 bonus to deny one psychic power.
Unique.

equipment.name: Wielder of Fates
equipment.desc: The player may demand a single die to be re-rolled each round, regardless from which player. Unique.

equipment.name: Osiron dreadnought
equipment.desc: The model may cast 1 power and deny 1 power per battle round. It knows Smite, both powers from a chosen Prosperine Cult discipline and all powers from a chosen General discipline except Biomancy. Walker only.

equipment.name: Resonant focus
equipment.desc: When selected as a target of a friendly's psyker's Augmentation psychic power, you can choose a friendly unit within 12" that this model has Line of Sight to. That unit gains the effects of the psychic power in addition of this model, if able.

equipment.name: Achean Configuration
equipment.desc:
- Castellax-achea Battle-automata Maniple units may be taken as Troops.
- On a roll of 4+, Castellax-achea Battle-automata Maniple units may ignore a Mortal Wound caused by a friendly unit suffering Perils of the Warp.

equipment.name: Axis of Dissolution
equipment.desc:
- Units automatically pass any Leadership test while within 6" of an objective.
- Units do not suffer the to hit penalty from Defensive Fire.
- Units taken as compulsory Troops choices must contain at least 20 models.
- The army must take more units with the Infantry type than the Vehicle type.
